MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

3. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

4. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

5. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

6. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 25

7. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 6
   C. 7
   D. 36

8. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 11

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 81

10. Solve for x: x + 5 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 5
   C. 6
   D. 10

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 33
   C. 28
   D. 22

12. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

13. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

14. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 29
   C. 11
   D. 28

15. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

16. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 13
   D. 169

17. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

18. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 5

19. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

20. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

21. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

22. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 2
   C. 10
   D. 14

23. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 45
   B. 36
   C. 30
   D. 18

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

26. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
